content: As a case study, we show two parameterizations of $R_\phi $ which instantiate distinct data manipulation schemes. The first example learns augmentation for text data, a domain that has been less studied in the literature compared to vision and speech BIBREF18, BIBREF38. The second instance focuses on automated data weighting, which is applicable to any data domains.
